details:
I found an issue in Udon Graph where using the same input/reference node instances in multiple execution paths of the same Branch can cause incorrect behaviour.

The issue occurs when both outcomes of a Branch perform separate logic, but reuse the same input/reference nodes inside those separate paths (for example: Transform, GameObject, Component, or similar nodes).

The behaviour is reproducible and happens consistently with the same graph setup.

Duplicating the input/reference nodes so that each Branch path has its own separate copies fixes the issue, even though the duplicated nodes have identical settings and receive the same inputs.

I have not confirmed whether this affects all node types, but I was able to reproduce it with input/reference nodes. The issue appears to occur before the execution paths merge back together and before the final execution node (for example, before SendCustomEvent).

I have attached two screenshots showing technically identical graph logic. The only difference is that one version reuses the same input nodes across both Branch paths, while the other uses duplicated input nodes. Only the duplicated version behaves correctly.

- Expected behaviour

The same input/reference nodes should be usable in multiple Branch execution paths without causing incorrect behaviour.

- Actual behaviour

Reusing the same input/reference nodes across different Branch paths causes incorrect behaviour. Creating separate copies for each path resolves the issue.

- Workaround

Duplicating the affected input/reference nodes for each Branch path resolves the issue.

- Environment

* Unity version: 2022.3.22f1

* Udon Graph version: 3.10.3
title: Udon Graph: Reusing input/data nodes before merged Branch paths causes incorrect behaviour
